The '''ZD-8000 cruise ship''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] model in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The ''[[Stellar Mermaid]]'', an opulant luxury liner, was a ZD-8000 cruise ship. The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sard Nightbringer]] staged an auction aboard the ship to auction off an experimental [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shield]].
